## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- List the affected areas.
- Note anything intentionally left unchanged.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:sites`

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated files.

- [ ] User-facing content is consistent with the Aleatur brand.
